svg.title: BidCraft: RAG proposal generator
svg.desc: Streams tailored Upwork proposals grounded in a freelancer's own past projects, retrieved by vector similarity in Postgres. Stack: FastAPI, Mistral, pgvector, Supabase, AWS Lambda. Built the backend. System: Upwork job post, Past projects, Saved memory, Editable prompts into RAG pipeline (pgvector top-k), out to Streamed bid, Q&A answers, Bid versions.
